title: Advance LDBC Query 14 past generate_subscripts and grouped projection gaps

steps.step: Verify BENCHPROD-104 20-row Q14 row-budget gap against reachable preload prefixes
Run a 40-row reachable-prefix LDBC diagnostic smoke to expose the next blocker
Implement minimal FROM generate_subscripts support for array literals and dependent joins
Implement Q14 downstream array subscript, array_agg, and COALESCE aggregate projection coverage
Fix PgWire Describe for SELECT * FROM derived subqueries so JDBC receives field structure
Run targeted SQL tests, pg integration, release build, and LDBC reachable-prefix smoke

evidence.reachability_probe: First 20 person_knows rows do not connect Q14 parameter pair; first 40 rows connect it at distance 4.

result.q14_20row_gap_reclassified: The 20-row preload row-budget gap is partly a harness/data-prefix artifact because the Q14 parameter pair is unreachable in the first 20 knows rows.
prefix40_progression: Unsupported expression in GROUP BY projection
Received resultset tuples, but no field structure for them
JDBC PgArray ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException while converting Q14 path array
result.current_frontier: LDBC Query 14 now reaches result conversion in the PostgreSQL implementation, but PgWire array type/text encoding is not compatible with JDBC PgArray decoding.

remaining_blockers: PostgreSQL array wire/text compatibility for nested path arrays returned by Q14
Full LDBC workload still unproven beyond the Q14 array conversion frontier
20-row LDBC diagnostic preload can create unreachable parameter-pair artifacts; reachable-prefix smoke should use at least 40 rows for this parameter file
next_task: BENCHPROD-106: implement PostgreSQL-compatible array result typing/encoding for nested arrays, then rerun Q14 reachable-prefix smoke
